plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: phone as a small anchor on the far left, the headline and its subheadline filling a wide central text column, and the orange CTA on the right with the legal line tucked small beneath it.
Message first: the headline leads from the left edge with the legal line set as a thin footer under it, then the phone and the CTA close the strip on the right as a product-plus-action pair.

Product-and-action lockup on the left (phone right beside its CTA button) with the headline taking the whole right two-thirds and the legal line running under it, so the copy gets the largest type possible.
